digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and Pass-1 judgment
propositions: A ticket may assert file_impact_scope: none, which must be validated so a false declaration cannot silence drift protection.
A new advisory LLM criterion no-file-impact judges whether a ticket declaring no repository-file impact actually requires editing a repository file.
The criterion is selected only when persisted scope is exactly none; paths, undeclared, missing, None, and unknown values fail closed with no LLM call.
The declared no_file_impact_reason is carried into the Pass-1 request via deterministic JSON structured context, with a missing reason serialized as an explicit empty string.

External-only deliverables produce PASS, required source/config/test/docs changes produce advisory contradiction findings, and vague plans produce non-blocking insufficient coaching, none of which block claim.
The packaged routing entry, canonical registry membership, rebar explain output, and idempotent criteria-guide regeneration must all validate.
